'''Parsel''' was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] in the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref>{{TCWdates|507}}</ref> Parsel piloted [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Acushnet/Legends|ship]] on his way to [[Raid on the Crucible/Legends|attack]] a group of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] and steal their lightsaber crystals.<ref name="A Test of Strength" />

Parsel later informed [[Jiro/Legends|Jiro]] that a ship's communication system was silenced, but working, and that there were life forms aboard the ship. After that, when it turned out that [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] were on the ship, this pirate along with Jiro and some of the other pirates joined them against [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]. Later on, when the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were overpowered by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Hondo, the remaining pirates joined Hondo again, and helped him to chase the brothers away from [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].<ref name="REV">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>
